thread_title: Iris verna var. smalliana SE Bartow Co, GA
breadcrumb: Iris verna var. smalliana SE Bartow Co, GA

posts.body_html:
I suppose all the other iris verna clones in the collection are also smalliana, as opposed to big...iana? Anyways, here's a new clone that originates from private property in Bartow Co, GA. It's a bit similar to the Cobb Co, GA clone, except the colors on this one are way more electric/vibrant purple, at least in person! The camera completely alters the color you see in person; nevertheless, it's still interesting to look at!

Iris verna var. smalliana SE Bartow Co, GA, pics taken 4/2/23. Literally, the day the flower opened(today), it got munched by insects and beat up by the wind, but it's the only flower for the year, so I figured it's worth documenting:


Lots of orange:

I have two clones from this population, this might be a different one from the pics above, not sure. Photos taken 4/2/24, crazy how they bloomed on pretty much the exact same day as last year:






I think this was divided a few months ago, these plants are so tough that even if you tear them into pieces, they can still bloom!

posts.body_html: Nice flower! Much longer orange & white marking than the 'regular' irises I grow in the garden, perhaps a deeper purple as well. Hopefully I can directly compare them next year, the iris rhizome from you is showing good growth.
